    Radical representatives of BGRS ray arrows #

    The chosen representative of an irreducible unit ray is nonzero and belongs to the ambient Jacobson radical of a finite-dimensional split-basic algebra.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.SplitBasicIdempotents.ProjectiveCategory.val_mem_ideal_of_unitRayEquivalent {k : Type u} [Field k] {A : Type v} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] {ι : Type x} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (S : SplitBasicIdempotents) {i j : S.ProjectiveCategory} (I : Ideal A) [I.IsTwoSided] {f g : i ⟶ j} (hf : ↑f ∈ I) (hfg : UnitRayEquivalent f g) :
    ↑g ∈ I

    Membership in any ambient two-sided ideal is invariant under endpoint-unit equivalence of primitive-projective morphisms.
